newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds flat, quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds flat, quiet market.

text.p: Argentine bonds were flat late morning Wednesday as the market lost its momentum from the previous session.
The declines in the U.S. market after strong manufacturing data "put cold water on the rise that started yesterday," said one trader at a foreign bank.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was flat at 89-1/4, while no trades were reported in the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2. That bond rose $0.05 to 124.70 Tuesday.
Another trader said the market was "very quiet," as investors remained on the sidelines, awaiting a clearer outlook on U.S. rates.
